name: Tai Seng
summary: CCL industrial-residential pocket between MacPherson and Bartley — warehouse-edge living with fast Circle Line hops and thinner weekend leisure defaults.
body: Tai Seng suits renters who already work along the Paya Lebar / Ubi / Bartley corridor and want the Circle Line without Serangoon hub crowds. Housing mixes older residences, newer condo inserts, and proximity to business parks — weekday energy, quieter Sundays. Expats shortlist it for door-to-desk math and relative value versus Dakota or Guillemard condo belts. Walk night and weekend: F&B and grocery gravity often lean on nearby MacPherson, Paya Lebar, or Serangoon rather than a self-contained town centre. Compare with MacPherson for denser HDB amenities, Paya Lebar for mall/office lifestyle, and Bartley / Serangoon when you want NEX-scale errands on the same line family.
